title: manifest
description: Bundle manifest (manifest.json): the authoritative file list with hashes and sizes, plus the set of files a reader must download. Drives delta sync by path+sha256 (DESIGN §4.3, §4.4).

content_fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the sorted (path, sha256) file list — a single-value identity for the bundle's content. Two bundles with the same book_id and revision but different content (e.g. a delete + re-make) have different fingerprints, letting a reader detect a changed bundle without diffing every file. Additive, content-derived; does not alter any page bytes.

bundle_version.description: Bundle format generation (v1 bundles are always 1).

files.description: Every file in the bundle, with content hash and byte size. The delta-sync unit: clients download new/changed paths by comparing sha256.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents.

reader_required.description: Glob patterns (bundle-relative) selecting the files a reader downloads by default; full-res archival plates are excluded (DESIGN §4.3).

items.description: One glob pattern selecting reader-required files.

total_bytes_reader.description: Total size in bytes of all reader_required files, for download-size display.
